hints.title: Trace Each Ball Independently
hints.text: Balls do not interact; trace the trajectory of each ball from top to bottom.

hints.title: Detect V-Shaped Traps
hints.text: If board at current col directs right (1) but adjacent right board directs left (-1), ball gets stuck.

hints.title: Check Boundary Wall Collisions
hints.text: If redirected column falls outside the grid boundaries 0 to n - 1, the ball gets stuck against the wall.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findBall(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        ans = []
        for col in range(n):
            curr = col
            for r in range(m):
                d = grid[r][curr]
                nxt = curr + d
                if nxt < 0 or nxt >= n or grid[r][nxt] != d:
                    curr = -1
                    break
                curr = nxt
            ans.append(curr)
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; simulating row-by-row traversal takes O(m * n) which is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracing each of n balls down m rows takes O(m * n) time and O(n) output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly detects wall bounds and opposite-diagonal V traps.
